w00-kickoff-ana-park.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, sage-green overshirt, white top, jeans) waves hello on a paved park path among trees, a lake behind; she matches her reference.

w01-how-people-arrive.observed_description: Beside a park, from left to right: a man in a red T-shirt rides a bicycle, an older woman in a blue dress walks with a handbag, a young woman steps out of a small red car with its door open, and a boy in a yellow T-shirt stands at the open door of a white bus at the right edge; all four separate, no text.
w01-how-people-arrive.note: Accepted: He goes by bike. / She walks. / She goes by car. / He goes by bus. Targets include each vehicle.

w02-what-they-have.observed_description: Four friends sit on a red picnic blanket: a woman takes a photo with a camera, a man wears big headphones, a woman looks at her wristwatch and a man holds an open wallet with cash; each person is large and separate.
w02-what-they-have.note: Accepted: She has a camera. / He has headphones. / She has a watch. / He has a wallet.

w03-light-and-dark-bags.observed_description: Four people stand far away on a park path holding light blue, navy, pale mint and forest-green tote bags; at full size the colors are right, but each person is about seven percent of the width and the light green reads almost white at phone size.
w03-light-and-dark-bags.note: REJECTED: targets too small to tap and the light green bag reads white on a phone; remade close up.

w04-taller-and-older.observed_description: Two pairs stand far away on the grass: a tall man beside a short woman in a red dress, and a grandfather holding a small boy's hand; each person is about five percent of the width.
w04-taller-and-older.note: REJECTED: targets too small to tap; remade close up.

w05-park-rules.observed_description: A boy swims far away in the lake, a girl draws chalk swirls on a low wall (some shapes look like letters), a man sits on a picnic table and two boys play football; the swimmer is about three percent of the width.
w05-park-rules.note: REJECTED: targets too small and letter-like chalk shapes; remade close up.

w06-it-isnt-a-phone.observed_description: Seen from above, a camera, a black smartphone with a dark screen, a silver wristwatch and a brown wallet lie in a row on a red-and-white checked picnic blanket in the park; each is large and separate.
w06-it-isnt-a-phone.note: Accepted: It isn't a phone. It's a camera. / It's a phone. / It's a watch. / It's a wallet.

q01-luis-asks-in-park.observed_description: Luis (short dark hair, navy crew-neck T-shirt) stands by a picnic table in the park, looks at the camera with a warm smile and holds one hand out, palm up, as if asking.
q01-luis-asks-in-park.note: Accepted: Luis asks Ana a question.

q02-diego-asks-in-park.observed_description: Diego (dark curly hair with a little grey, short beard, burgundy shirt) stands on the park path, smiles at the camera and opens one hand, palm up, as if asking.
q02-diego-asks-in-park.note: Accepted: Diego asks Ana a question.

q03-sofia-asks-in-park.observed_description: Sofia (long curly dark hair, bright blue blazer, white blouse) stands by the lake, smiles at the camera and holds one hand out, palm up, as if asking.
q03-sofia-asks-in-park.note: Accepted: Sofia asks Ana a question.
